decisions.statement: The body is handed in whole rather than as a passage.
The body that body was composed against may be handed in beside it.
A body handed in that is not the body there refuses the change unwritten.
A caller handing none in writes over whatever the path holds.
Writing the body is left to the partial this change runs.
The checks judge the tree the edits leave.
The index files a page this change writes.
A later act in the same change names a page this change wrote.

definition: one body written at one path, judged by the checks a landing runs
